annotations.description: Prometheus could not scrape {{ $labels.job }} on {{ $labels.instance }} for five minutes.

rules.expr: (sum by (job) (rate(swf_http_requests_total{job=~"stumpfworks.*",status=~"5.."}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (job) (rate(swf_http_requests_total{job=~"stumpfworks.*"}[10m])), 0.001)) > 0.05 and sum by (job) (rate(swf_http_requests_total{job=~"stumpfworks.*"}[10m])) > 0.1

annotations.summary: StumpfWorks HTTP error ratio is high
annotations.description: More than five percent of requests for {{ $labels.job }} returned 5xx while traffic was active.
{{ $labels.job }} recorded repeated directory failures in the bounded {{ $labels.stage }} stage.
{{ $labels.job }} recorded repeated directory timeouts in the bounded {{ $labels.stage }} stage.

rules.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (job, stage, le) (rate(swf_directory_lookup_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"stumpfworks.*"}[10m]))) > 2 and sum by (job, stage) (rate(swf_directory_lookup_duration_seconds_count{job=~"stumpfworks.*"}[10m])) > 0.01

annotations.description: The p95 directory duration for {{ $labels.job }} in {{ $labels.stage }} exceeded two seconds while lookups were active.
{{ $labels.job }} used more than 85 percent of its PostgreSQL pool for ten minutes.
{{ $labels.job }} recorded repeated canceled PostgreSQL pool acquisitions.
